Description: You can earn your crafting writ certification to qualify and and then get to fulfilling writs today! Open the map, and look for the marketplace in most major cities across Tamriel. You'll find the crafting job boards nearby!
Pop open the Group and Activity Finder tab to check out the Group Finder. There you'll find all manner of social activities to collaborate, and crush, with your fellow players!
Team up for victory! Check out currently available listings by opening up the guild tab!

Activity: Complete the Quest "Room to Spare" or Visit a Player Home
Description: You deserve a place to kick up your feet. Speak with Felande Demaire at inns in the capital cities across Tamriel to unlock your very own home!
Activity Reward: File:ON-icon-furnishing-Breton_Chair,_Slatted.png Breton Chair, Slatted Tea Table, Carved Common Candles, Pair Breton Carpet, Green Alliance Banner Furnishing Coffer

Description: We are Undaunted! You can find their questgivers, or join up, at the Undunted Enclaves near Elden Root, Mournhold, or Wayrest. Dive into dangerous delves to gain skill line progress and valuable rewards!

Activity: Complete the Fungal Grotto I Dungeon 1 Time
Description: Clear the Fungal Grotto I dungeon, located in Stonefalls.
Player guilds pay for the services of loyal traders in major cities across Tamriel. Open the map and look for the scales-and-shield icon. Go see what's on offer!

Outfit Stations are posted up in large cities throughout Tamriel. Open the map and look for the triple swirl icon. At an Outfit Station you can dye your current gear or even put together an all new look with any motifs you've unlocked.
Activity Reward: File:ON-icon-Outfit Change Token.png 3 Outfit Change Tokens Forest: Vineyard Tint Mixture Darkening: Black Mantra Golden: Pearls and Gold

Description: Complete challenges and earn Tome Points. You can then exchange Tome Points for unique rewards within the Tomes Screen. Access the Tomes screen at any time by pressing F4.
